gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subject has a prior histologically confirmed diagnosis of a grade 4 glioblastoma multiforme (GBM)

candidate_evidence.quote: CHM-1101 CAR-T cells (other names: Chlorotoxin (EQ)-CD28-CD3zeta-CD19t-expressing CAR T-lymphocytes (via ICT/ICV dual delivery)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapsed disease: radiographic evidence of recurrence/progression of measurable disease after standard therapy

role_evidence.quote: CHM-1101 CAR-T cells (other names: Chlorotoxin (EQ)-CD28-CD3zeta-CD19t-expressing CAR T-lymphocytes (via ICT/ICV dual delivery)

source_quote.quote: Confirmed MMP2+ tumor expression by IHC (≥20% moderate/high MMP2 score \[2+ or 3+\]).

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR T-cell product (excluded type), so MMP2 is not candidate-matched (no candidate). Eligibility also allows grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytoma alongside IDH-wildtype GBM; GBM named in conditions so coded gbm_only; cns5 chosen because IDH status is used to distinguish entities. CAR-T persistence in tumour cyst fluid/CSF is cell-product kinetics of a non-candidate, coded no.
